title: With -dflambda-heavy-invariants, "New equation ... has unbound local names" on a recursive function
summary: With `-dflambda-heavy-invariants`, Simplify stops on `let rec f (Node l) = List.iter (fun x -> List.iter (fun y -> f y) x) l` with "New equation ... has unbound local names".

actual.text: The compiler stops with `New equation ... has unbound local names`, exit status 2.

cause: `middle_end/flambda2/simplify/simplify_set_of_closures.ml`, `simplify_set_of_closures0`: a constant lifted out of the body of a recursive function gets its type outside the set of closures before the function's symbol is defined there.

fix.text: Defines the closure symbols in the environment before the bodies are simplified, since the types of the constants lifted out of them can name those symbols. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
